title: Finite-state proofs
description:
This repository supplies exact, replayable certificates for eleven published recurrences, for strip widths 2 through 7, that count binary rectangular arrays containing exactly one, or at most one, occupied horizontal or antidiagonal edge.

Status: proposed computer-assisted proofs, checked by exact integer code and small exhaustive enumeration; awaiting human review.

These are proofs of existing formulas, not new sequences or a claim to have found the first proofs. No OEIS submission has been made.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse

The counting problems, recurrence coefficients, and selected initial terms are from the OEIS entries by R. H. Hardin listed in sources.json. Source URLs are pinned to the OEIS Git export commit 61a45ae71d35453a862da1bc68adfa6e4984411d, inspected on 25 October 2026 (UTC).
